answers.core_task: Understand what to look at today in 10 seconds.
answers.never: Never present anything as financial advice. Never use bare finance jargon. Never touch the live app — design work in demo/mockup only.
answers.what: Revamp TradeDesk, the stock-research app, with the new global UX/UI skill. Mock B (Command center, editorial ledger) is already chosen as the Daily Brief layout.
answers.who: A reader with no finance background checking what to look at today.

branching.device: Phone first, then tablet and laptop.
branching.login_needed: Yes — Supabase Auth (Google + email) with an invite allow-list.
branching.replaces: Checking Yahoo Finance, newsletters, and a watchlist across several tabs each morning.

classifiers.audience_note: Invite-only app: Ankit plus invited members (first invitee Dipesh). Not open to the public, but the reader is not Ankit himself — design for a stranger with no finance background.
classifiers.user_types_note: One reader persona (non-expert investor). Admin/member is an access distinction, not a design persona.

known_facts.detail_tab_rule: Every detail tab shows all available details; only the Daily Brief stays focused on key items.
known_facts.live_data: Yahoo Finance (chart + options), Schwab Trader API (real-time quotes incl. Greeks), Congress trades (Quantgress second source), Nasdaq earnings calendar, SEC EDGAR, Google News RSS.
known_facts.research_only: Research and education only, never financial advice.
